# AuraLink Digital Agency — AI & LLM Machine-Readable Specification
> AuraLink Digital Agency is an elite AI-powered digital agency specializing in Autonomous AI Agents, Custom Web & Mobile Software Development, Business Websites, Technical SEO Architecture, and Workflow Automation.

## Core Services & Offerings
- **Websites & E-Commerce**: Landing Pages, Local Business Websites, E-Commerce Platforms, 3D WebGL Motion Websites, Website Redesigns. (Express Delivery in 48 Hours)
- **Autonomous AI Agent Solutions**: Voice Calling Agents, 24/7 WhatsApp API Business Bots, AI Sales Representatives, Lead Qualification Agents, Employee & Client Onboarding Bots. (Deployed in < 3 Business Days)
- **Custom Software Solutions**: Full-Stack SaaS Platforms, Custom Web Apps, Mobile Apps (iOS/Android), Enterprise CRM & ERP Systems, Internal Admin Dashboards. (Delivered in < 7 Business Days)
- **Technical SEO & Digital Marketing**: Technical SEO Audits, Schema.org Architecture, On-Page & Local SEO, Google Business Profile Optimization, Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO).
- **Engineering Tech Stack**: Next.js 14, React 18, TailwindCSS, Python FastAPI, Node.js, PostgreSQL, Redis, OpenAI GPT-4o, ElevenLabs Voice API, Twilio, WhatsApp Cloud API, Docker, AWS.
